Desc.SourceString: 所有商品根据大亨等级解锁。非限定的商品会定期刷新，限定商品仅可购买一次。
Desc.LocalizedString: Items unlock according to your Tycoon Level. Non-limited items refresh regularly, while limited items can only be purchased once.

Desc.SourceString: 永久开放，通关后仅可领取一次奖励。
Desc.LocalizedString: Permanently available. Rewards can be claimed once per completion.

Desc.SourceString: 周期性开放的高难关卡，内容与奖励随版本更新。
Desc.LocalizedString: Rotates periodically with tougher stages, updated content, and exclusive rewards.

Desc.SourceString: 周期性开放的高难关卡，内容与奖励随版本更新。
Desc.LocalizedString: Rotates periodically with tougher stages, updated content, and exclusive rewards.

Desc.SourceString: 周期性开放的高难关卡，内容与奖励随版本更新。
Desc.LocalizedString: Rotates periodically with tougher stages, updated content, and exclusive rewards.

Desc.SourceString: 周期性开放的高难关卡，内容与奖励随版本更新。
Desc.LocalizedString: Rotates periodically with tougher stages, updated content, and exclusive rewards.

Desc.SourceString: 由鉴定师在城市中巡查、调查并处理各类常规异象。成功完成后可获得相应奖励。
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraisers patrol the city to investigate and handle routine Anomalies. Complete these assignments to earn rewards.

Desc.SourceString: 赌徒「21」将赢来的筹码丢在城市各处，想要得到奖励，需要先解决一些麻烦......
Desc.LocalizedString: Gambler "21" has scattered the chips they won across the city. Want the rewards? You'll have to deal with a few problems first…

Desc.SourceString: 点亮家具收藏获得收藏值，收藏值符合要求时可领取奖励。
Desc.LocalizedString: Unlock entries in the Furniture Collection to earn Collection Points. Earn enough Collection Points to unlock rewards.

Desc.SourceString: 猎人等级提升后，可前往猎人奖励界面领取对应等级的奖励。
Desc.LocalizedString: As your Hunter Level increases, visit the Hunter Rewards screen to claim rewards for each level.

Desc.SourceString: 在都市大亨中累计获得方斯并达成任务目标即可提升等级，每级均享升级权益及对应奖励。
Desc.LocalizedString: Earn Fons and complete objectives in City Tycoon to level up. Each level grants its own perks and rewards.

Desc.SourceString: 完成房屋装修指南内置目标可领取奖励。
Desc.LocalizedString: Complete the objectives in the Property Renovation Guide to claim rewards.

Desc.SourceString: 完成一咖舍商铺经营指南内置目标可领取奖励。
Desc.LocalizedString: Complete the objectives in the Management Guide for The Cafe by Origen to claim rewards.

Desc.SourceString: 「店长特供」玩法中累计达成经营目标可得环石奖励。
Desc.LocalizedString: Earn Annulith rewards as you complete business objectives in Owner's Selection.

Desc.SourceString: 「海上钓客」玩法中提高垂钓等级及收集垂钓图鉴可得环石奖励。
Desc.LocalizedString: Earn Annulith rewards in Sea Angler by increasing your Fishing Level and collecting Fishing Index entries.

Desc.SourceString: 阳光、沙滩、排球！光脚踩在细沙上，与队友配合扣杀救球。
Desc.LocalizedString: Sunshine, sand, and volleyball! Feel the sand beneath your feet as you team up for spikes and digs.

Desc.SourceString: 勇者小队集结完毕！目标是征服整片沃伦大陆！
Desc.LocalizedString: Team assembled and ready to conquer the Warren Continent!

Desc.SourceString: 面对更强大的异象，仅在达成目标条件后才会开放挑战。高危委托包含多档挑战难度，完成后将获得丰厚的奖励。
Desc.LocalizedString: Challenges against stronger Anomalies unlock only after you meet the requirements. High-Risk Commissions offer multiple difficulty levels and generous rewards upon completion.

Desc.SourceString: 欢迎来到噗卡乐园，奇妙旅程就此开启！
Desc.LocalizedString: Welcome to Pukaland, where your magical journey begins!
